blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Bolivar Heights. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Bolivar Heights rose from 11 in June to 14 in September, and 2 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 0.9% of Surrey’s 1,523 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Bolivar Heights?
Bolivar Heights also had 79 houses listed and 8 sold in September, against 14 condos and townhomes listed. The Bolivar Heights houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Bolivar Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 14 condos and townhomes listed in Bolivar Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Bolivar Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Bolivar Heights had a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Bolivar Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 condos and townhomes sold in Bolivar Heights over those 4 months, out of 591 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
